maternal American Society of Anesthesiologists (ASA) grade
outcome: Reasons for general anesthesia in cesarean section
cohort: 98 parturients who underwent cesarean section under general anesthesia at Peking Union Medical College Hospital from January 1, 2014 to December 31, 2016
finding: Pregnancy with internal or surgical diseases was the most common reason (60.2%) for choosing general anesthesia for cesarean section, and high ASA grade and short gestation period were associated with high postoperative ICU admission rate and low one-minute Apgar score.
